title: Fortune For Netherite
description: This mod ensures that the “Fortune” enchantment works on netherite.
body:
![FORTUNE](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4b1fe1b71fd7dd8b1dcc1e33224c623f2f3f49e6.png) 
Tired of the endless Ancient Debris grind? This mod introduces a simple but effective tweak: the Fortune enchantment now works on Ancient Debris! Just like mining diamonds, your Fortune pickaxe will yield more materials, making your expeditions to the Nether much more rewarding.

## Features
- **Vanilla Friendly**
- **Mining Netherite is easier**
- **For version 1.21.8**
